audio.t: Hi, I'm with the Larkin Pharma group in the Maple Room. The microphone on the podium isn't working, and our first speaker starts in ten minutes.
I'm sorry about that. Our technician is in another building right now, but I can bring you a wireless microphone from the front desk.
That would be perfect. Could you also check the air conditioning? It's getting quite warm in here.
Of course. I'll adjust it from the control panel on my way back.

questions.prompt: Where most likely are the speakers?
questions.evidence: I'm with the Larkin Pharma group in the Maple Room
questions.explanation: Groupe installé dans une salle (Maple Room), personnel avec une réception et un technicien : ils sont dans un hôtel.
questions.traps: « Pharma » est le nom du client, pas le lieu.
questions.takeaway: Front desk + salles nommées → hôtel / centre de conférence.

questions.prompt: What does the man offer to do?
options: Move the group to another room
questions.evidence: I can bring you a wireless microphone from the front desk
questions.explanation: Il propose d'apporter un micro sans fil de la réception pour remplacer le micro défectueux.

questions.prompt: What does the woman also ask about?
questions.evidence: Could you also check the air conditioning? It's getting quite warm in here.
questions.explanation: Elle demande de vérifier la climatisation car il fait chaud : c'est la température de la salle.

audio.t: Good morning. I reserved a compact car under the name Feldman, for pickup today.
Yes, Mr. Feldman. Unfortunately, our last compact car was returned with a flat tire, so it's not available. I can give you a midsize car for the same price, though.
That's fine, as long as it doesn't use much more fuel. I'll be driving about six hundred kilometers.
It's a hybrid, so it's actually more economical. I just need to see your driver's license and a credit card.

questions.prompt: Why is the reserved car unavailable?
options: It was rented by another customer.
It was sent to another branch.
questions.evidence: our last compact car was returned with a flat tire
questions.explanation: La dernière petite voiture est revenue avec un pneu crevé : un pneu endommagé.

questions.prompt: What is the man concerned about?
questions.evidence: as long as it doesn't use much more fuel
questions.explanation: Il accepte à condition que la voiture ne consomme pas beaucoup plus : sa préoccupation est la consommation de carburant.
questions.takeaway: As long as = à condition que (exprime une réserve).

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask the man to provide?
questions.evidence: I just need to see your driver's license and a credit card
questions.explanation: Elle demande le permis de conduire et une carte de crédit : des documents d'identification et de paiement.
questions.traps: (D) : elle demande une carte, pas d'espèces.

audio.t: Ahmed, Lucy, I just heard from finance. They won't approve next year's marketing budget until the end of the month.
That's a problem. We need to sign the contract with the advertising agency by the fifteenth.
Could we sign a short agreement for the first quarter only? That amount is already covered by this year's budget.
That could work. Lucy, can you draft that agreement and send it to me by Thursday?
Sure, I'll use last year's template.

questions.prompt: What problem are the speakers discussing?
options: An advertising agency has raised its fees.
A budget decision has been delayed.
questions.evidence: They won't approve next year's marketing budget until the end of the month.
questions.explanation: Le service financier n'approuvera le budget qu'en fin de mois : la décision est retardée.

questions.prompt: What does Lucy suggest?
questions.evidence: Could we sign a short agreement for the first quarter only?
questions.explanation: Elle propose un accord court, limité au premier trimestre, déjà couvert par le budget actuel.
questions.traps: Rien n'indique qu'elle veuille changer d'agence ou repousser la campagne.
questions.takeaway: Short / for the first quarter only → limited.

questions.prompt: What will Lucy use to complete her task?
questions.evidence: I'll use last year's template
questions.explanation: Elle utilisera le modèle de l'an dernier : un document antérieur.

audio.t: Are you driving to the trade fair tomorrow? I was thinking of parking at the Central Garage.
Yes, but I'm only staying for the morning sessions. I'll arrive at nine and leave around noon.
I'll be there all day, from eight until about six. By the way, the garage takes only cards, not cash.
Good to know. I'll make sure to bring my company card.

questions.prompt: Where are the speakers going tomorrow?
questions.evidence: Are you driving to the trade fair tomorrow?
questions.explanation: Ils se rendent tous les deux au salon professionnel.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. How much will the woman most likely pay for parking?
questions.explanation: Elle reste de 9 h à midi environ, soit 3 heures : tarif « 2 à 4 heures », 7 €.
questions.traps: 16 € correspond à la journée de l'homme (8 h–18 h).
questions.takeaway: Calcule la durée (9 h → 12 h = 3 h) avant de lire le tableau.

questions.prompt: What does the man say about the garage?
options: It offers a discount for visitors.
questions.evidence: the garage takes only cards, not cash
questions.explanation: Le parking n'accepte que les cartes, pas les espèces.

audio.t: Hi Daniel, I'd like to schedule the second interview with the logistics candidate, Ms. Brandt. Are you free Tuesday afternoon?
Tuesday's tricky. I'm visiting the Lille warehouse all day. What about Wednesday morning?
She mentioned she's only available in the afternoons this week. She's still working her notice period.
In that case, let's do Thursday at two. I'll ask Paola from operations to join us, since Ms. Brandt would be working on her team.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.evidence: I'd like to schedule the second interview with the logistics candidate
questions.explanation: Ils cherchent un créneau pour le second entretien d'une candidate.

questions.prompt: Why is Ms. Brandt unavailable in the mornings?
options: She is attending a training course.
She still has obligations at her current job.
questions.evidence: She's still working her notice period.
questions.explanation: Elle effectue encore son préavis : elle est toujours tenue par son emploi actuel.
questions.traps: (B) concerne l'homme (visite de l'entrepôt de Lille).

questions.prompt: What does the man plan to do?
options: Invite a colleague to the interview
questions.evidence: I'll ask Paola from operations to join us
questions.explanation: Il va demander à Paola, du service des opérations, de participer à l'entretien.
questions.takeaway: Join us = se joindre à nous.

audio.t: Elena, our subscription to the design software expires next week. The renewal price has gone up by twenty percent.
Twenty percent? How many of the fifteen licenses are we actually using?
Well, the two summer interns left in August.
Then let's renew thirteen licenses instead. And check whether there's a discount for paying annually rather than monthly.

questions.prompt: What problem does the man mention?
questions.evidence: The renewal price has gone up by twenty percent.
questions.explanation: Le prix du renouvellement a augmenté de 20 %.

questions.prompt: Why does the man say, "the two summer interns left in August"?
options: To indicate that some licenses are not being used
To explain why a project is late
To complain about a staffing shortage
questions.evidence: Well, the two summer interns left in August.
questions.explanation: Elle demande combien de licences sont utilisées ; il répond que deux stagiaires sont partis : deux licences sont donc inutilisées. Elle conclut d'en renouveler 13.
questions.takeaway: Intention : relie la phrase à la question qui précède et à la décision qui suit.

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask the man to check?
options: Whether the licenses can be transferred
questions.evidence: check whether there's a discount for paying annually rather than monthly
questions.explanation: Elle veut savoir si un paiement annuel donne droit à une réduction, donc s'il est moins cher.
questions.takeaway: Annually = chaque année ; monthly = chaque mois.

audio.t: Hello, this is Nadia from Le Petit Four bakery. I'd like to increase our weekly flour order from twenty to thirty bags, starting next week.
Business must be going well! I can do that, but deliveries of more than twenty-five bags need to be scheduled for Monday mornings.
Monday's fine, but we open at seven, so the delivery would need to arrive before six thirty.
Our first truck leaves at five, so that won't be a problem. I'll send you an updated contract today.

questions.prompt: Why is the woman calling?
questions.evidence: I'd like to increase our weekly flour order from twenty to thirty bags
questions.explanation: Elle veut augmenter sa commande hebdomadaire de farine : elle modifie une commande.
questions.takeaway: Increase an order = augmenter une commande.

questions.prompt: What condition does the man mention?
options: Large orders must be paid in advance.
Large deliveries must take place on a specific day.
Deliveries are limited to twenty-five bags.
questions.evidence: deliveries of more than twenty-five bags need to be scheduled for Monday mornings
questions.explanation: Les livraisons de plus de 25 sacs doivent avoir lieu le lundi matin : un jour précis.
questions.traps: (D) déforme l'information : 25 sacs est un seuil, pas une limite.
questions.takeaway: Need to be scheduled for = doivent être programmées pour.

questions.prompt: What will the man send the woman?
questions.evidence: I'll send you an updated contract today.
questions.explanation: Il enverra un contrat mis à jour : un accord révisé.

audio.t: I need a room for Friday's workshop on customer service. Fourteen people have signed up so far.
Registration is still open until Wednesday, though. Last time, about five more people registered at the last minute.
Good point. And since the workshop runs all day, it'd be nice to have somewhere to make coffee.
Then there's really only one option. I'll reserve it now.

questions.prompt: What is the workshop about?
questions.evidence: Friday's workshop on customer service
questions.explanation: L'homme réserve une salle pour l'atelier de vendredi consacré au service client.

questions.prompt: Why does the woman mention the last workshop?
options: To suggest that more people may attend
To explain why it was canceled
questions.evidence: Last time, about five more people registered at the last minute.
questions.explanation: Elle rappelle que des inscriptions tardives ont eu lieu : le nombre de participants pourrait augmenter.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which room will the woman most likely reserve?
questions.explanation: Il faut environ 19 places (14 + ~5) et un endroit pour faire du café : seule la salle 201 (24 places, kitchenette) convient.
questions.traps: La salle 102 (16 places) serait trop petite et n'a pas de kitchenette.

audio.t: Hi, I started in the legal department on Monday, but my badge doesn't open the door to the third floor.
Let me look you up. Ah, I see. Your badge was set up with visitor access only. Someone must have selected the wrong option.
That explains it. I've been waiting for colleagues to let me in all week.
I've corrected it now, but the change takes about an hour to update in the system. Try again after lunch.

questions.prompt: What is the man's problem?
options: His badge does not give him the right access.
He is in the wrong building.
questions.evidence: my badge doesn't open the door to the third floor
questions.explanation: Son badge n'ouvre pas la porte du 3e étage : il n'a pas les bons droits d'accès.

questions.prompt: What caused the problem?
questions.evidence: Someone must have selected the wrong option.
questions.explanation: Le badge a été paramétré avec un accès visiteur par erreur : c'est une erreur de configuration.

questions.prompt: What does the woman tell the man to do?
questions.evidence: Try again after lunch.
questions.explanation: La modification prend environ une heure : il doit réessayer après le déjeuner.

audio.t: The delegation from Okuda Electronics arrives tomorrow at ten. Is everything ready for the factory tour?
Almost. The safety helmets have arrived, but we still need to print the visitor badges.
I can take care of the badges. I'll just need the visitors' full names.
I'll forward you their e-mail. Oh, and Mr. Okuda doesn't eat meat, so I've asked the caterer for a vegetarian lunch option.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers preparing for?
questions.evidence: The delegation from Okuda Electronics arrives tomorrow at ten.
questions.explanation: Ils préparent la visite d'une délégation d'une entreprise cliente.

questions.prompt: What does the second man need?
questions.evidence: I'll just need the visitors' full names.
questions.explanation: Pour imprimer les badges, il a besoin des noms complets des visiteurs.

questions.prompt: What has the woman arranged?
questions.evidence: I've asked the caterer for a vegetarian lunch option
questions.explanation: Elle a demandé au traiteur une option végétarienne pour M. Okuda.

audio.t: Hi, this is Grace from Hollis Interiors. Six of the glass lamps we received from you this morning are broken.
I'm very sorry. Were the boxes damaged when they arrived?
No, the boxes looked fine, but there wasn't enough padding inside.
I see. I'll ship six replacements by express delivery today, at no charge, and I'll talk to our packing team about this.

questions.prompt: Why is the woman calling?
options: She wants to place a new order.
questions.evidence: Six of the glass lamps we received from you this morning are broken.
questions.explanation: Six lampes en verre sont arrivées cassées.

questions.prompt: What does the woman imply about the damage?
options: It was caused by the delivery driver.
questions.evidence: there wasn't enough padding inside
questions.explanation: Les cartons étaient intacts mais le rembourrage insuffisant : les dégâts viennent de l'emballage.
questions.traps: (A) est exclu : les cartons extérieurs n'étaient pas abîmés.

questions.prompt: What does the man promise to do?
questions.evidence: I'll ship six replacements by express delivery today
questions.explanation: Il enverra six lampes de remplacement en express aujourd'hui, gratuitement.

audio.t: Have you found a photographer for the anniversary gala yet?
I've contacted three. The one I liked most, Inès Moreau, charges almost twice as much as the others.
Well, the photos will be used in our annual report and on the website for the whole year.
True. I'll ask her if she can reduce the price if we only need four hours instead of six.

questions.prompt: What event are the speakers discussing?
questions.evidence: the anniversary gala
questions.explanation: Ils cherchent un photographe pour le gala d'anniversaire.

questions.prompt: Why does the man say, "the photos will be used in our annual report and on the website for the whole year"?
options: To ask the woman to take the photos herself
To explain why the report is late
To suggest that a higher price may be justified
questions.evidence: the photos will be used in our annual report and on the website for the whole year
questions.explanation: Face au prix élevé, il souligne que les photos serviront toute l'année : la dépense pourrait se justifier. Elle répond « True ».

questions.prompt: What will the woman ask Ms. Moreau?
options: Whether she is available on another date
Whether she can lower her fee for fewer hours
Whether she can edit the annual report
questions.evidence: I'll ask her if she can reduce the price if we only need four hours instead of six
questions.explanation: Elle demandera une baisse de prix pour 4 heures au lieu de 6.
questions.takeaway: Reduce the price = lower the fee.

audio.t: Our lease on the forklifts ends in December. Should we renew it or buy our own machines?
Buying would cost about eighty thousand euros up front, but we'd save on monthly fees after three years.
And maintenance is included in the lease, isn't it?
It is. That's a big advantage. Let me prepare a cost comparison over five years, including maintenance, and we can decide next week.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers deciding?
options: Whether to buy or lease equipment
questions.evidence: Should we renew it or buy our own machines?
questions.explanation: Ils hésitent entre renouveler la location des chariots élévateurs et les acheter.

questions.prompt: According to the speakers, what is an advantage of leasing?
options: It costs less over five years.
It can be canceled at any time.
questions.evidence: maintenance is included in the lease
questions.explanation: L'entretien est inclus dans la location, ce que l'homme confirme comme un gros avantage.

questions.prompt: What will the man do next?
questions.evidence: Let me prepare a cost comparison over five years
questions.explanation: Il va préparer une comparaison des coûts sur cinq ans.
